MARS

MARS 用 3D Swin 加结构/序列双支路、元数据与对比约束，并通过重建/合成把 anatomy-invariant 与 sequence-specific 信息解耦。

Multi-sequence 3D MRI foundation model pairing a 3D Swin backbone with dual structure/sequence branches and acquisition metadata to disentangle anatomy from contrast.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 跨 10 个解剖区、多 MRI 序列的 3D volume 及其遮挡/跨序列变体 Multi-sequence 3D MRI volumes across 10 anatomical regions with sequence metadata and cross-sequence masking
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 可迁移 3D Swin 表示，以及供分割、分类、配准、预测和报告任务使用的权重 Disentangled anatomical and sequence representations transferable across 44 segmentation, classification, registration, and report tasks

MATHEMATICAL FORMALISM
核心公式 · 结构—序列解耦及采集参数约束
Core Formalism · Anatomy–Sequence Disentanglement Conditioned on MRI Acquisition Parameters
01 // PRIOR LIMITATION
上一代瓶颈

单序列、单器官预训练难处理临床 MRI 协议和对比度异质性

Single-sequence or single-organ MRI models brittlely fail when clinical pulse sequences, TR/TE parameters, or contrasts vary.

02 // CORE HYPOTHESIS
核心想法

在大规模多序列 MRI 上解耦 anatomy-invariant 表征与 sequence-specific variation

Explicitly factorize 3D MRI representations into an anatomy-invariant structural branch and a sequence-specific contrast branch guided by acquisition metadata.

03 // ARCHITECTURAL DELTA
关键改进

以 sequence-disentangled pretraining 迁移到 44 个分割、分类、配准、进展预测和报告生成任务

Pretrained on ~160,000 3D MRI scans via cross-sequence synthesis, masked reconstruction, and contrastive disentanglement.

04 // MEDICAL TRANSLATION
医学适配

适配多器官 MRI 分割、诊断、配准、进展预测与报告生成

Adapts across 44 diverse downstream MRI tasks spanning segmentation, diagnosis, deformable registration, progression, and reporting.

05 // EVIDENCE & BOUNDARY
适用范围与证据

原作者在 44 个任务中报告 41 个第一；不等于独立或前瞻验证

Broad multi-task scope reported by authors; independent external replication under standardized baselines remains necessary.

ARCHITECTURAL AXIOMS // 设计原理与数学机制
  • 3D Swin 共享主干，但显式拆出解剖结构与 MRI 序列变化两类 latent。
  • 结构/序列对比和部位/采集参数预测让两个支路承担不同信息。
  • 遮挡重建与受 sequence latent 调制的合成任务补充体素级生成约束。
  • Core Hypothesis: Explicitly factorize 3D MRI representations into an anatomy-invariant structural branch and a sequence-specific contrast branch guided by acquisition metadata.
  • Architectural Delta: Pretrained on ~160,000 3D MRI scans via cross-sequence synthesis, masked reconstruction, and contrastive disentanglement.
  • Mathematical Formalism: Anatomy–Sequence Disentanglement Conditioned on MRI Acquisition Parameters.
CLINICAL TRANSLATION & BOUNDARIES // 医学应用与安全边界
  • 同一预训练权重可接分割、分类、配准、进展预测与报告生成适配器。
  • 44 项结果来自异质任务和不同 heads，不能把总体胜出直接解释为单一临床场景已前瞻验证。
  • Clinical Translation: Adapts across 44 diverse downstream MRI tasks spanning segmentation, diagnosis, deformable registration, progression, and reporting.
  • Evidence & Safety Boundary: Broad multi-task scope reported by authors; independent external replication under standardized baselines remains necessary.
